The surface derivation algebra, taught

Pedagogy·seedling·proposed·JUL 10, 2026

The wire-contract vocabulary study that fed the reactive bridge. The combinators-as-shipping-plan framing is superseded — surface-reactive-bridge is the ratified direction, and the fate of every name here is decided there. What remains load-bearing: the before/after combinator studies as the demand inventory (the real hand-rolls with file:line cites), the laws with their why, the no-shared-frame arguments, and the exhaustive reflex→surface mapping as the wire-semantics matrix the bridge inherits.

Where this note stands: the shipping direction is the reactive bridge — backend members ride a signals engine behind reactor.ts — and the fate of every name below is decided there (deriveCell/scanCell survive as derived.cell/.scan; foldCollection and combineCells dissolve into computed; scanStream survives off-graph; pollCollection survives as derived.collection.fromPoll; registryFromFamily splits into reactiveFamily + derived.registry), as are the open questions’ dispositions. This note remains the study the bridge stands on: the before/after combinator sections are the demand inventory (the real hand-rolls, with their file:line cites), and the appendix table is the wire-semantics matrix the bridge inherits.

The study’s one idea — a derived member is a declaration: you state what it derives from and how; the framework owns the wiring, the seeding, the dedup, and the reconnect story. Ground trees for every file:line cite: kolu origin/master, drishti master. Two working words: a tick is one producer microtask flush (precedent: createTickCoalescer, packages/surface/src/server.ts:281-312), and each deriver owns its own flush; the wire has no shared frame — each member travels its own channel at its own latency.

The problem, in one cell

padi’s urgency cell is a pure function of the terminals collection — computed today by five write seams that must each call publishUrgency (packages/padi/src/terminalEndpoint/metadata.ts:110-112, called at :104), a separate removal-path refold (:129-132), a prose invariant (:28-35), and a separate boot seed (servePadi.ts:180). Forget one seam and the badge silently lies. The same hand-wiring repeats across both trees: kolu-server’s onState cells (packages/server/src/index.ts:842-853), four samplers (index.ts:881, index.ts:797-810, packages/padi/src/hostInventory.ts:331, packages/padi/src/memorySampler.ts:61), the already-extracted pipeSessionStateToCell (connectionPipe.ts:36-64) with its private error policy, drishti’s three poll reconciles in one function (agent main.ts:262-330) with a hand-held dedup (main.ts:90-106) and a hand delta bus (main.ts:211-221), and drishti’s drifted registry clone (packages/app/src/server/hostMapRegistry.ts, clockOffset hardcoded 0). The declaration idea deletes all of it.

The lineage, in three names

The primitives already map onto reflex (the attention primer’s table; why four primitives, not one). fmap: a derived value is a function of another. foldDyn: a value is an accumulation, its carried state owned by the machinery. Incremental: a keyed map whose changes travel as patches. The appendix maps everything else.

The combinators — before and after

Each shipping combinator in five fields: why · for · before (real code at master) · after (the declaration) · reflex.

foldCollection

Why: urgency is a pure function of terminals, held together by five call sites and a prose invariant. For: a cell derived from a sibling collection.

Before — packages/padi/src/terminalEndpoint/metadata.ts:100-112 (one of the five seams, plus the funnel):

  padiSurfaceCtx.collections.terminals.upsert(
    terminalId,
    composePadiTerminal(entry),
  );
  publishUrgency();
}
// …repeated at every write seam, plus the removal path (:129-132)

function publishUrgency(): void {
  padiSurfaceCtx.cells.urgency.set(recomputeUrgency());
}

After:

cells.urgency = foldCollection({
  from: "terminals",
  fold: (entries) => ({ awaitingIds: liveAwaitingIds(entries) }),
}); // seeds from fold(readAll()); every write seam arms it; urgencyEqual stays on the spec

Reflex: fmap over incrementalToDynamic — a whole-map refold, stateless.

observableSource

Why: callback sources are hand-subscribed with .set calls inside the handler — wiring, teardown, and error policy re-decided per site. For: the adapter from any push callback to the one upstream shape every deriver accepts.

Before — packages/server/src/index.ts:840-850:

padiSession.onState((s) => {
  koluSurfaceCtx.cells.padiLink.set(mapConnectionToPadiLink(s.phase));
  // …
  koluSurfaceCtx.cells.processStartedAt.set({
    server: serverStartedAt,
    padi: padiStartedAt(),
  });
});

After:

const states = observableSource((emit) => padiSession.onState(emit));
cells.padiLink = deriveCell(states, (s) => mapConnectionToPadiLink(s.phase), DEFAULT_LINK);
cells.processStartedAt = deriveCell(states, bootTimes, INITIAL_BOOT_TIMES);

Reflex: hold (a push source’s last frame, held). pipeSessionStateToCell (connectionPipe.ts:36-64) dies the same way, its catch-and-keep-consuming (:53-63) promoted into deriveCell’s per-frame policy — one law where three spellings lived.

pollSource

Why: four samplers each hand-roll “read a value, re-read when something happens, write a cell” (index.ts:881, index.ts:797-810, hostInventory.ts:331, memorySampler.ts:61). For: a cell derived from a read-on-tick source; no isEqual of its own — dedup is the target cell’s spec equals.

Before — packages/server/src/index.ts:799-810:

startMemorySampler(
  liveSamplerDeps({
    publish: (m) => koluSurfaceCtx.cells.processMemory.set(m),
    readPadiMemory: readPadiMemoryOnce,
  }),
  // …
  (resample) => padiSession.onState(() => resample()),
);

After:

cells.processMemory = deriveCell(
  pollSource({ read: readMemoryOnce, install: (on) => padiSession.onState(on) }),
  (m) => m, MEMORY_ABSENT);

Reflex: hold over a sampled Behavior.

scanCell

Why: some derived values are accumulations. drishti’s alerts hysteresis (“crossed 80 to raise, fell below 70 to clear”) is undecidable from the current sample — carried state — and is the committed consumer (both W5 phases ship as one campaign, .claude/rules/surface.md). padi’s MRU feed is a read-modify-write against the very cell it publishes. For: a cell derived through carried state, seedable from a store.

Before — packages/padi/src/activity.ts:73-83:

export function trackRecentRepo(repoRoot: string, repoName: string): void {
  const feed = padiSurfaceCtx.cells.activityFeed.get();
  const next = upsertMru(
    feed.recentRepos,
    { repoRoot, repoName, lastSeen: Date.now() },
    // …
  );
  padiSurfaceCtx.cells.activityFeed.set({ ...feed, recentRepos: next });
}

After:

cells.alerts = scanCell(observableSource(systemTicks), hysteresisStep,
  { level: {}, window: [] });   // no store — a level must not survive restarts
cells.activityFeed = scanCell(activityEvents, applyMru,
  (stored) => stored ?? EMPTY_FEED, { store: confStore }); // restart resumes the MRU

Reflex: foldDyn / Accumulator. The activityFeed adoption is conditional on trackRecent* becoming emitter publishes (open question 5 — they are synchronous, so the buy is one-writer structure, not a race fix); the mutating read at activity.ts:50-57 is a second writer and gets fixed regardless.

scanStream

Why: a time-series member needs catch-up — snapshot, then live deltas — and the hand-roll snapshots first and subscribes after, so a delta born in the gap is lost until reconnect. For: a stream derived through carried state, wire face snapshot(state)-then-deltas via subscribeBeforeSnapshot (server.ts:350-363).

Before — drishti packages/app/src/server/router.ts:198-208:

metricHistory: {
  source: async function* (_input, signal) {
    yield {
      kind: "snapshot",
      samples: [...historyRing],
    } satisfies MetricHistoryMsg;
    for await (const msg of historyBus.subscribe(signal)) {
      yield msg;
    }
  },
},

After:

streams.metricHistory = scanStream({
  upstream: observableSource(systemTicks),
  step: recordSample, initial: emptyRing(),
}); // each subscriber gets subscribe-BEFORE-snapshot — the window closes

Reflex: mapAccumDyn. The hand ring + bus (router.ts:108-117) and the sink fusing system.set with recordSample (router.ts:279-289) die; pushSample (common/history.ts:94-103) survives as pure logic.

pollCollection + CollectionSpec.equals

Why: poll a keyed source, diff against what you serve, upsert changed, evict vanished — the most-repeated hand-roll in both trees (three production instances in one drishti function, main.ts:262-330; four more in kolu’s teaching examples: fleet-top parts 1–3, remote-process-monitor). For: a collection derived from a keyed poller; the diff’s equality is the collection’s declared equals (Object.is fallback), which ships with it.

Before — drishti packages/agent/src/main.ts:283-296:

if (prev === undefined || processChanged(prev, value)) {
  fragment.ctx.collections.processes.upsert(pid, value);
  upserts.push([pid, value]);
}
// …
for (const pid of processSnapshot.keys()) {
  if (!nextProcesses.has(pid)) {
    fragment.ctx.collections.processes.remove(pid);
    removes.push(pid);
  }
}
if (upserts.length > 0 || removes.length > 0) {
  snapshotDeltaBus.publish({ kind: "delta", upserts, removes });
}

After:

collections.processes = pollCollection({
  read: readProcesses,  // Promise<ReadonlyMap<pid, Process>>
  install: everySecond,
}); // spec: { equals: processChanged } — the hand delta bus dies into the deltas verb

Reflex: no single name — the Incremental twin of poll-and-hold. The hand snapshotDeltaBus + processesSnapshot stream (main.ts:211-221, :295) are deleted (the collection already declares deltas, common/surface.ts:249, and the framework path has no lost-update window); the paired PR narrows drishti’s agent-written collections from wire upsert/delete (common/surface.ts:249, 258) to ["keys","get","deltas"] — one-writer becomes wire-true for drishti too.

registryFromFamily

Why: serveHostMap hand-holds the keyed family — frame cache, links cache, fused fire, attach with per-member error isolation, membership reconcile — and drishti cloned it (hostMapRegistry.ts, clockOffset hardcoded 0): two authorities, drift already real. For: the map’s serving seam (a pull-shaped MapRegistry); collections gain the connect seam pollCollection needs.

Before — packages/surface-remote/src/serveHostMap.ts:145-152:

const latestState = new Map<string, SessionState<string>>();
const stateSubs = new Map<string, () => void>();
const links = new Map<string, unknown>();
const changeListeners = new Set<() => void>();

const fire = (): void => {
  for (const l of [...changeListeners]) l();
};

After:

const registry = registryFromFamily({
  members,
  attach: (host, emit) => sessionFor(host).onState(emit),
  resolve: projectState,   // undefined → the honest connecting arm
  linkFor,                  // resolve-time memo, evicted on member exit
});

Reflex: mergeIncrementalG / Adjustable, server half. projectState (:52-77) survives as the one resolve with causeFor (:109-113) composed in; drishti declares the same core and imports the shared projection — the clone dies (its stated reason, a ClockableSession bound, is resolved by resolve taking last: F | undefined). Whether padi’s registry exposes one onChange collapsing the five publishComposedTerminal seams (metadata.ts:142-171, 182-213, 221-229, 245-248, 120-122, through composePadiTerminal :73-81) is open question 6.

The boot checks — what becomes unspellable

One writer. implementSurface rejects, at wiring, any derived member whose resolved verbs (resolveCellVerbs define.ts:206 / resolveCollectionVerbs define.ts:223) include set, patch, upsert, delete, or test__set (define.ts:54, :260-261 — a wire mutation like any other); tests reset a derived member by writing its source. Non-derived cells are exempt: padi’s session (surface.ts:595-599, verbs ["get","test__set"]) keeps its named imperative writers.

No declared cycles. The from-declared sibling graph (foldCollection / combineCells / gateEvent / scanCollection) is walked at wiring; a cycle is a boot error. Free-form upstreams (scanCell over an arbitrary iterable) are invisible to the walk; their documented semantics are equals-gated fixpoint termination — a value-converging loop quiesces at the equals gate, a non-converging one is a declared-graph bug (livelock). Reach: open question 10.

The laws, stated once

  1. One writer. A derived member with a second writer is two authorities racing — the urgency disease. Wire-read-only, boot-enforced, test__set included.
  2. Dedup solely at the target member’s spec gate — cell equals (server.ts:198-207, 1469-1474) or collection equals (phase 1). A private predicate inside a deriver would be a second, invisible gate; pollSource and pollCollection carrying none is the rule applied.
  3. Snapshot-then-delta everywhere. A derived member is indistinguishable from an ordinary one: cell store replay; subscribeBeforeSnapshot for scan streams; the collection deltas snapshot.
  4. Seed from truth. Mirrors never fabricate — a fold starting from a default publishes a value nobody asserted. Only push-source holds use the declared default, the one writer’s property.
  5. Fail-fast, on the statefulness line. A sync in-tick fold that throws is a producer defect mid-flush: it escapes and crashes. An async stateless pump (deriveCell, registryFromFamily’s resolve, pollCollection’s tick read) logs the frame’s failure and keeps consuming, holding the last published value — frames are independent, the next one self-heals, nothing is fabricated by continuing. An async stateful pump (scanCell, scanStream) stops, holding last state — its carried state missed a frame, so continuing would fabricate. onError defaults to stderr, never invisible. deriveCell (project.ts:236-280) splits accordingly: pump death → stop holding last value (a dead iterator can’t be consumed); per-frame failure → skip and continue. Escalation of a stopped stateful pump is open question 7.

What the wire refuses — no shared frame

Per-member channels share no frame, so “at the same moment” is unsayable — and that one fact decides the whole absent family. Switching (switch/switchHold*/coincidence/Dynamic join): a switching occurrence must carry an Event as its value, but a wire frame is Zod-schema’d data (define.ts:245-265); the only serializable stand-in is a channel handle — a capability with dead epochs after reconnect, no definable snapshot obligation, and a second writer on “which stream is current”; and the promptly trichotomy needs the shared frame that isn’t there. What survives is first-order: the switching index travels as data (a per-key get held open on an absent key is switchHold never’s idle state, server.ts:382-417) and the client re-subscribes — scopedByEntry (scoped.ts:81-210) is the switching machinery. Cross-channel combines (Align/Zip/Apply, difference, wire zipDyn, wire attach): simultaneity-defined, so intersection is meaningless and every union collapses to interleave (mergeSources, deferred); same-process combines are legal (combineCells, deferred), client pairing is a Solid memo. The same fact retires tagPromptlyDyn: folds always see the post-write value (store.set precedes bus.publish, server.ts:198-207) — uniformly “promptly”, no old/new distinction left to spell. Briefly: PushM/PullM — the server process is the monad; *Cheap — a Haskell pull-graph perf contract with no analog; Query/crop/SelectedCount — per-member subscription + AbortSignal already is the query (revisit at range/viewport subscription over a large collection); maybeDyn/factorDyn/demux — client memos and Solid <Show>/<Switch>.

Left alone, deliberately

  • padi’s session autosave (packages/padi/src/session.ts:19-65): the session cell has multiple legitimate writers — restore’s clear, restart’s capture, the autosave fold, the wire test__set (surface.ts:595-599). A fold declaration would be a lie the boot check turns into a boot failure; not a derivation target, so the one-writer check doesn’t apply.
  • remotePadiBinding.ts:721-740: a scan-shaped hold feeding the pull-shaped PadiSession accessor facade, not a surface member; becomes scanCell demand only if convergence is ever served as a member.
  • padi’s daemonStatus chain (daemonStatus.ts:76): already the wrapped-path collection publish.
  • kaval’s PTY-attach protocol (inProcessPtyHost.ts:138, 232): kaval’s own attach API, not a surface member.
  • surface-map’s client side (client.ts:93-125, 530-543; scoped.ts:81-210): correct client-policy homes; makeEntryClock (client.ts:132-140) is a pure lens.

What waits

Deferred — name · reflex · trigger

  • collectionFromFamily · reflex mergeIncrementalG · trigger: surface-map’s serving seam consuming a collection member — the keyed-family core’s collection face (population-zero today; shares registryFromFamily’s hold/reconcile/project, adds the wrapped publish leg via the connect seam).
  • deriveCollection · reflex unsafeMapIncremental (the Incremental fmap) · trigger: first projectSurface exposing a collection member — patch-preserving per-key map whose reconnect diff hard-depends on the target’s declared CollectionSpec.equals (Object.is fallback stated, never an invisible deep-equal).
  • combineCells · reflex zipDynWith/pull/attach · trigger: first derived member reading two sibling sources — same-process only (cross-surface zip deliberately absent: no transactional frame), seeds from both stores, recompute coalesced on its own flush.
  • SKIP on deriveEvent · reflex fmapMaybe/ffilter · trigger: first projection narrowing an event feed — events only (dropping a stream’s first frame breaks snapshot-then-delta, define.ts:58-63; hold-last-passing-value is scanCell).
  • gateEvent · reflex gate · trigger: with SKIP, first sibling-gated feed — drops upstream frames while a sibling cell’s current value fails a predicate; same-process only.
  • scanCollection · reflex accumIncremental · trigger: a foldCollection measured too hot at full refold over large N (urgency today is a deliberate, cheap full refold, urgency.ts:23-38) — folds emitting collection patches, seeded from truth.
  • mergeSources · reflex merge/leftmost/mergeWith, collapsed · trigger: first N-source event member — plain interleave; no cross-channel simultaneity, so the three conflict policies are vacuously one combinator.

The open questions

The calls still open — what a review of this note rules on.

  1. Typed sibling references. foldCollection/combineCells/gateEvent/scanCollection name siblings by string key, boot-checked (existence + verbs + cycles). Compile-time from means threading keyof through the deps builder — the second type materialization projectSurface avoids for TS union-budget reasons (project.ts:288-290, 62-72). Is boot-time throw enough, or is a keyof-only generic affordable?
  2. The tick — refold suppression. foldCollection owns its flush. With CollectionSpec.equals in phase 1, should a flush in which every same-tick upsert was equals-suppressed skip the refold entirely, or is one spec-equals-gated cell publish per armed tick cheap enough? Measure on the ~150ms composed-terminals firehose before adding the skip.
  3. scanCell durability — migration. The signature is fixed (store param; seed from store.get()); the remaining question is version skew: a persisted S whose shape changed across a deploy. Does the initial(stored) function form (caller-owned migration/validation, fail-fast on unparseable) suffice, or do persisted scans need a declared versioned-migration seam?
  4. The registryFromFamily wrapper’s home. The combinator deletes serveHostMap’s cache/fire/reconcile and drishti’s clone; causeFor enrichment (serveHostMap.ts:109-113), the #1716 belt (:259-265), and offsetOf injection (:40-44, 85-95) compose into resolve. Does the composed wrapper stay in surface-remote (shared with drishti), or does drishti import only the projection? Either kills the clone; the package boundary needs an electricity-test ruling.
  5. The activityFeed restructure. scanCell subsumes padi’s activityFeed only if trackRecentRepo/trackRecentAgent become emitter publishes — is that churn worth it now, or does it wait, with only the read-path back-write (activity.ts:50-57, a mutating read) fixed immediately?
  6. The metadata write-seam collapse. The connect seam ships with pollCollection regardless. Does padi’s registry expose the one onChange that collapses the five publishComposedTerminal seams, or does that path keep its convention with only the urgency rider deleted?
  7. Fail-fast — visibility of a stopped stateful pump. The doctrine line is ruled (sync in-tick = crash; async stateless = log-skip-continue; async stateful = log-stop-hold). Remaining: should a stopped stateful pump escalate beyond stderr — e.g. flip the liveness gate (define.ts:143) so the freeze is visible on health() — given the history with frozen-but-live-looking members (#1034)?
  8. Cross-surface zip. Hard-rule it client-side forever (no transactional frame on the wire), or leave the deferred combineCells open to a cross-surface variant with documented eventual consistency if demand ever names one?
  9. scanMsgSchema vs collectionDeltasSchema. Unify ScanMsg with CollectionDeltasMsg (a keyed scan is a collection; an unkeyed one isn’t) or keep distinct authorities? Unifying lets scanStream consumers reuse the collection client fold; it also blurs “collection = keyed, patchable” (define.ts:75-87) for a member with no keys.
  10. The cycle rule’s reach. The boot cycle check covers only from-declared edges; scanCell over an arbitrary upstream iterable is invisible to it. Is “equals-gated fixpoint termination + a documented livelock-is-a-bug rule” enough for the free-form subset, or should scanCell-over-a-sibling-cell get a declarative from spelling so its edge joins the checked graph?
  11. pollCollection cadence composition. install owns the cadence (interval, event, or both — drishti wants interval + immediate first tick; kolu’s samplers want event-triggered resample). Is one install seam enough, or do interval-and-event-fused cadences deserve a tiny shared helper so each caller doesn’t re-spell “setInterval + onState + fire now”?

Appendix — the reflex→surface mapping, exhaustively

Legend: EXISTS (file:line, verified in-tree) · ADD-SHIP (ships phase 1, demand named) · ADD-DEFER (cataloged above, trigger named) · N/A (argued). File cites are kolu packages/surface/src/… unless another package is named.

reflex combinator / family verdict surface analog
§0 primitives
Behavior EXISTS stream member (define.ts:152-155): derived, read-only, sampled at will. Server-side, any sibling cell’s current value is also a Behavior: deps.store.get() read synchronously (server.ts:198-207).
Event EXISTS event member (define.ts:157-160): occurrence, no snapshot obligation (project.ts:172-179).
Dynamic EXISTS + phase 1 cell (define.ts:89-144) is the value half; the change half is phase 1’s updated() on the client Subscription, change-iff-fired enforced at the producer by spec equals (server.ts:198-207).
Incremental EXISTS collection with the opt-in deltas verb (define.ts:64-87): snapshot = PatchTarget, coalesced upserts/removes = the patch; one wire authority collectionDeltasSchema (define.ts:274-287).
currentIncremental EXISTS the collection’s snapshot half: server readAll() / client per-key get + keys — the current PatchTarget without the patch stream.
updatedIncremental EXISTS the deltas verb’s delta frames alone — the patch stream without the snapshot (a client that skips frame 1).
incrementalToDynamic EXISTS snapshot + client-side fold of deltas into a whole-map view — what the deltas verb’s client consumer does (surface-map’s folded entry collection decodes the same one authority).
PushM / PullM N/A the server process is the monad — handlers are arbitrary TS reading stores synchronously.
never EXISTS an event member nobody publishes.
constant EXISTS a cell default with no writer; inMemoryCell(initial) (project.ts:242).
push / pushAlways / pushCheap EXISTS / ADD-DEFER always-firing map = deriveEvent (project.ts:180-187); the Maybe-filtering half is the deferred SKIP return. Cheap variants N/A (graph-caching contract; a surface bus is already multicast).
pull ADD-DEFER server / EXISTS client server-side multi-cell recompute = combineCells (deferred); client-side, a Solid memo over useCell subscriptions already is pull.
switch, coincidence N/A see the switching argument above.
current / updated EXISTS / phase 1 the client accessor half exists today; updated() change pairs are phase 1.

mergeIncrementalG / …WithMoveG ADD-DEFER collectionFromFamily — keyed sources joining/leaving under a membership reconcile, as a collection member. The live keyed-family consumer feeds a pull-shaped MapRegistry instead — that face ships as registryFromFamily. Trigger for the collection face: surface-map’s serving seam consuming a collection member.
behaviorCoercion etc. N/A TS structural typing makes coercions free.

§1 pure map/filter
fmap (Event/Dynamic/Behavior) EXISTS deriveEvent (project.ts:180-187), deriveCell (project.ts:236-280, error policy per the statefulness line), deriveStream (project.ts:163-170).
fmapMaybe / ffilter / filterLeft / filterRight ADD-DEFER SKIP-returning map on deriveEvent ONLY. Illegal on streams: dropping the first frame breaks snapshot-then-delta reconnect (define.ts:58-63); a “filtered stream” is a cell/scan holding the last passing value (scanCell).

gate ADD-DEFER gateEvent: drop upstream frames while a sibling cell’s current value fails a predicate; same-process only.

Cycle safety is the boot cycle rule + equals-gated fixpoint termination.
§3 fan-in
merge/mergeWith/leftmost/mergeList ADD-DEFER mergeSources — interleave N upstreams into one event member. No cross-channel simultaneity ⇒ the three conflict policies are vacuously one combinator.
mergeMap / mergeInt / mergeIntIncremental EXISTS the deltas coalescer: N same-tick keyed mutations publish ONE upserts/removes frame (createTickCoalescer, server.ts:281-312); tick = microtask.
alignEventWithMaybe / difference N/A simultaneity-defined.
mergeIncremental / mergeMapIncremental(WithMove) ADD-DEFER the collection-member face of the keyed-family core (collectionFromFamily).
unsafeMapIncremental ADD-DEFER deriveCollection — patch-preserving per-key map; hard dependency on CollectionSpec.equals (phase 1) for its reconnect diff.

fanEither / fanThese composition (deferred) two SKIP-filtered derived events off one upstream — needs the filter ADD.
filterEventKey / factorEvent N/A the key travels as data and the client re-subscribes; stop-permanently semantics have no demand.
fanInt / EventSelectorInt N/A perf specialization of fan.
§5 hold-class (stateful)
hold/holdDyn ADD-SHIP observableSource (+ deriveCell) and pollSource (the cell twin of the stream read/install shape; no isEqual — dedup at the target cell’s spec equals).
Accumulator (accum*), foldDyn/foldDynMaybe* ADD-SHIP scanCell — (state, frame) => state fold into a cell; accumMaybe’s “Nothing = no update” = return the previous state reference. Demand: drishti’s committed alerts scan (paired-PR campaign) + deriveCell/scanStream implemented on its loop; the padi activityFeed adoption is conditional (open question 5).
mapAccumDyn/mapAccumB (state + output, snapshot-worthy) ADD-SHIP scanStream — carried state + per-frame delta, wire face snapshot(state)-then-deltas via subscribeBeforeSnapshot (server.ts:350-363).
mapAccum_ family / numberOccurrences* / zipListWithEvent N/A → raw source the state-discarded variants output an Event with no snapshot obligation — neither scanStream (imposes a snapshot face) nor scanCell (produces a cell) fits; the honest analog is a raw source generator closing over carried state (project.ts:172-179). No named combinator until demand names one.
accumIncremental (fold to a PATCH) ADD-DEFER scanCollection — fold emitting collection patches instead of full refolds. Trigger: a foldCollection measured too hot at full refold (urgency today is a deliberate, cheap full refold, urgency.ts:23-38).
scanDyn/scanDynMaybe/mapDynM ADD-SHIP scanCell with a cell upstream (its get iterable, or observableSource on its bus).
count/toggle N/A named one-line scanCell instances.
tailE/headTailE/takeWhileE/…/improvingMaybe N/A prefix/suffix machines; a raw source generator; no in-repo demand.
§6 switching (higher-order)
switch/switchHold*/switcher/switchDyn/switchPromptlyDyn/coincidence/coincidencePatch* N/A on the wire the switching argument above; the index travels as data, the client re-subscribes; scopedByEntry (scoped.ts:81-210) is the client-side switching machinery.
join (Dynamic-is-a-Monad, unkeyed) N/A wire a cell-of-cell is unspellable as wire data (the inner cell would travel as a channel capability); the outer value is data, the client re-subscribes. Keyed joinDynThroughMap is the collection row (§8).
maybeDyn/eitherDyn/factorDyn N/A wire client-side discriminated rendering: a memo on the discriminant; Solid <Show>/<Switch>.
§7 uniqueness
holdUniqDyn / holdUniqDynBy EXISTS producer-side spec equals (define.ts:124), enforced on both write paths (server.ts:198-207, 1469-1474). THIS is where equals lives: at the ONE writer’s publish gate, never inside a deriver, never at a mirror.
UniqDynamic + ptr-equality N/A explicit, reviewable predicate on the spec; JS has no WHNF/ptr semantics to exploit.
alreadyUniqDynamic EXISTS the per-write force equals bypass (server.ts:1238) for re-serve rebind epochs.
stream uniqueness EXISTS (poll shape) pollOnEvent’s isEqual yield gate (server.ts:540-561, gate at :557) — streams have no spec-equals gate, so the source owns it; cells do, which is why pollSource carries none.
collection VALUE uniqueness ADD-SHIP CollectionSpec.equals gating per-key publish + coalescer enqueue (server.ts:1585-1600), mirroring the cell gate. Live demand: drishti’s processChanged (agent main.ts:90-106) is this predicate, hand-held at the write site today. Ships with pollCollection, whose diff is defined in terms of it.
demux N/A wire selection is client state; demuxed(k) = a client memo.
§8 combining / distribution
zipDyn / zipDynWith ADD-DEFER server / N/A cross-surface / EXISTS client server-side combineCells, recompute coalesced per microtask tick on its OWN flush. Cross-surface wire zip deliberately absent: independent channels can present (new a, old b); no transactional frame restores glitch-freedom.
distributeMapOverDynPure / joinDynThroughMap / distributeList* EXISTS the collection IS the distributed map: deltas = a coherent whole-map view per tick; keys+get = the per-key view.
splitDynPure composition two derived cells off one upstream.
constDyn / unsafeDynamic EXISTS cell default with no writer / the raw-source escape hatch.
HList machinery / collectDynPure N/A TS structural records; n-ary combineCells, deferred with it.
Num/IsString/Semigroup instances N/A sugar over fmap/zip.
§10 Adjustable + collection UIs
Adjustable/runWithReplace/traverse*WithAdjust(WithMove) EXISTS client / ADD-SHIP server client: scopedByEntry (scoped.ts:81-210). Server: the keyed-family core ships as registryFromFamily (the MapRegistry face its one live consumer feeds); collectionFromFamily deferred.
listHoldWithKey/listWithKey/…/simpleList same scopedByEntry / watchByEntry (client); registryFromFamily → collectionFromFamily (server).
networkView/networkHold/untilReady N/A whole-graph replacement is a process/UI concern: Solid <Show>/Suspense client-side; server-side, the re-serve rebind epoch (force republish, server.ts:1238).
§11 Query
Query/crop/QueryMorphism/SelectedCount/MonadQuery/queryDyn N/A as API per-member subscription + AbortSignal IS a query declaration; subscriber counts are SelectedCount; abort is the decrement-to-zero prune. Crop policy is app-level (W7 K1). A genuine analog becomes worth building at range/viewport partial subscription over a large collection.
deprecated inventory N/A aliases of covered combinators.
